auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2013' THEN t.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012' THEN t.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012' THEN t.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percentage_change
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM'
  AND t.XCL_012 = 'EUR'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) IN ('2012', '2013')
